name: Mesha (King of Moab)
title: The Rebellious King of the Moabites
summary: Mesha was king of Moab and a shepherd who paid tribute to Israel. After Ahab's death, he rebelled, and in a desperate situation during the siege, he sacrificed his own firstborn son on the wall.

keyEvents.title: Rebels Against Israel
keyEvents.description: Mesha, king of Moab, rebelled against Israel after Ahab's death and refused to pay the large tribute of lambs and wool.
